acceptance_2_principal.subject: pantheon-dev-consultation-memory-writer
acceptance_2_principal.scope: learn-feedback as write_authority consultation-svc only; cannot write as telemetry-svc (403 in test); no operator/admin/system/memory-writer
acceptance_2_principal.delivery: file in dev-paper-consultation-tokens volume, mounted :ro at /run/pantheon-principals; consultation-svc PANTHEON_MEMORY_AUTH_TOKEN_FILE points to it, read per request (file takes precedence over env token)

acceptance_3_idempotent_retry.cause: Stable memo idempotency key (mem-summary-<meeting>) with re-synthesized different text on retry made POST /api/consult/memos return 409 (comparable payload differs).
acceptance_3_idempotent_retry.fix: _HttpMeetingStoreProxy.put_memo treats 409 as the existing record for that request, memo_type and author_ref (GET /api/consult/memos?request_id=), then publish (already idempotent). 409 without an existing record is still raised.
acceptance_3_idempotent_retry.test: services/consultation/tests/test_persona_meetings.py::test_retry_after_blocked_writeback_reuses_recorded_memos_and_closes_mt1 (fails without the fix, passes with it)

acceptance_4: Same test: real executor, MT-1 chair persona-alpha + persona-risk-officer, two rounds, blocked 403 writeback then retry -> closed, closed_at set, writebacks recorded, exactly one committee_summary and one dissent memo, no dead_letter.

acceptance_5_synthesis_review.finding: Not a parse defect in stance handling: REVIEW is the expected outcome class when the chair returns REVIEW or nothing readable. But the code gave a chair-declared REVIEW with a readable summary the misleading text 'Synthesis empty or unreadable'.
acceptance_5_synthesis_review.fix: validate_and_build_synthesis keeps the chair's own summary when it declares REVIEW with a summary; empty/unreadable keeps the old text.
acceptance_5_synthesis_review.unverified: Whether the hosted chair output on mtg-485f7ab2970844ae was explicit REVIEW or empty was not inspectable from code; operator can read its synthesis event.

acceptance_6_budget.per_meeting: 1 learn-feedback writeback (source_event_id consultation:meeting:<id>, replays instead of duplicating), 2 memos (summary + dissent), plus 1 participant-outcome memory per participant inside that single writeback
acceptance_6_budget.retries: At most 3 attempts (CONSULTATION_WORKFLOW_MAX_BLOCKED_ATTEMPTS); retries add no memos (409 reuse) and the writeback is idempotent
acceptance_6_budget.per_day: Bounded by the meeting cadence (weekly per persona/type via schedules); hosted scale of one operator-convened or cycle-convened meeting per trading persona per week is <=1 writeback and 2 memos per meeting per day per persona; no new writer
